question: C9X, E25V, G49T, I81R, ?
solution:
The logic is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d176200bf7541a3833111329e49b938be3174da13d105e04de99899349e94db.png] 

**Logic for number: **Square of the position value of the first letter in the group as follows:

C9X → Position value of C is 3 → 3² = 9

&
lt;p>E25V → Position value of E is 5 → 5² = 25

G49T → Position value of G is 7 → 7² = 49

I81R → Position value of I is 9 → 9² = 81

Similarly, 

K121P → Position value of K is 11 → 11² = 121

Hence, K121P is the correct answer.
